lines.instruction: push ebp; Static analysis: handles received player_say events; userid -> index 1..64; sender/local m_iTeamNum inequality; stores 76-byte record before output gates. No server-side message acquisition established.
lines.label: ChatSpy_OnGameEvent
comments: Static analysis: handles received player_say events; userid -> index 1..64; sender/local m_iTeamNum inequality; stores 76-byte record before output gates. No server-side message acquisition established.

lines.instruction: call ChatSpy_PackWideCodeUnits; Reads 16-bit words, emits low byte then high byte, stops at first zero BYTE (including high-byte zero). Compatible with reconstructing a raw C string; wchar_t decompiler types do NOT prove that the event text is UTF-16. Not a Unicode conversion.
call ChatSpy_HasMatchingHudMessage; Compare normalized (name, text) pair against normal-HUD cache. No userid, sequence, or time limit in this comparator. Return value consumed as AL bool.
